note: Numpad notation, facing right: 6 = forward, 4 = back, 2 = down, 8 = up, 236 = quarter circle forward. Craft Gauge: 4 bars (400%), kept between rounds. You build it by landing hits (more) and by being hit or blocking (less); whiffs give nothing, and a move that spends meter gives its user none. After spending meter, gains are cut to a quarter for 3 seconds. Below 35% health it slowly fills by itself. Burst gauge: starts full, kept between rounds, refills over time (faster at low health) and when you're hit.

sections.title: Normals
moves: Rising Slash: launches; any normal cancels into it; jump (8) on hit to chase (no jump cancel on block)

sections.title: Specials
moves: Stationary quickdraw: A cuts straight ahead with a long lightning slash; B cuts diagonally upward (anti-air, launches)
1 bar. Stationary rapid slash barrage, 6 hits; the last one blasts them away (hard knockdown)
A: short dash, B: longer dash. The dash itself doesn't hit
a palm strike out of either dash
C during the dash (or hold B)

She slashes them from the front (it does not cross up), then passes through and ends up on the other side. Very unsafe on block. On hit she sheathes her sword and they are lifted slightly; a counter hit gives extra time to follow up
invincible lightning dash; on hit she slashes through them again and again (the old EX Dash Slash)
Two-hit rising crescent slash. A: rises about as high as Leticia's 623A, not invincible; a hard knockdown early in a combo (normal knockdown late in a long one). B: invincible start, goes higher

1 bar. Invincible two-hit rising crescent; on hit she turns into lightning at the peak, comes slashing straight down onto them half a second later, holds them in the air while she sheathes her blade, then the sheath click unleashes a last slash and they fall (hard knockdown). Without 1 bar = B
Diving slash; slams airborne opponents down
1 bar. Invincible dive; the lightning X on landing is a pillar that launches them (+3 on block)

sections.title: Supers (3 bars)
moves: Ground or air. In the air she plunges down: anyone she touches on the way is dragged to the floor and takes the whole surge
Counter stance; when it catches a hit she crosses through them four times (one hit) and sheathes on her own side

sections.title: System
moves: needs a FULL Burst gauge and uses all of it; works in hitstun (not out of every special / EX / super hit). Does no damage, knocks them away
On the ground: dash forward, or back dash with back held. In the air: air dash forward, or back with back held
hold A / B / C (air) or any button (ground)
knocked into the air: holding a button techs as soon as you can (hold forward to tech forward). Knocked down: any button
